email.subject: Bit -- Investigation
email.body:
Hmmm.
I've been around a while, but I've never seen anything like this. It's a bit early to call it unbreakable but... this is new. Different. Hmm. EnTech huh? They make, what, a pretty mediocre antivirus? If they were selling whatever this is, they'd be making a fortune.
Hey, look, their front end stuff doesn't have anything this fancy. I'm going to get digging from the web server end - see at what point this new stuff starts. It looks like it's deep enough in that they're trying to hide it for some reason. No idea why - it looks like it'll be a huge hassle to get past - companies love that stuff. This is new and flashy too.
This is suspicious as hell. Take a look on your end and see how far you can get in here - I don't know if it's just me, but this feels like a way better lead than I was even hoping for.
Ping me back when you think you've seen as much as you can. Be Thorough.
-V
